digest.component_or_area: plan-review prompt cache-prefix seam (Pass-1 finder / Pass-2 verifier)
propositions: The anthropic cache breakpoint covers the whole system block, so only byte-identical full system prompts share a cache entry, and the Pass-2 verifier keeps its plan in the USER message and gains no plan-bearing cache benefit.

A single-sourced code seam (SHARED_STANCE_PREAMBLE + shared_plan_prefix in prompts.py) emits a byte-identical leading plan-bearing prefix shared across the Pass-1 finder and both verifier system prompts to enable provider-side prefix reuse and prevent drift.
passes._SHARED_PREAMBLE is deleted and moved verbatim into prompts.py, gaining one new exhaustiveness-directive bullet instructing enumeration of every independent defect found in the current run.

The verifier templates lead with {{shared_prefix}} and delete their trailing volatile marker and plan block, so split_volatile takes its no-marker path and the whole rendered template becomes the stable system prompt while the per-run finding listing stays user-turn as base_instructions.

plan_review_verify_inputs stops emitting a plan output and instead emits shared_prefix, with the output schema and both plan-review.yaml verify with: blocks updated accordingly; runs.py needs no change.

The Pass-1 finder warm gate is changed to measure _prefix_tokens(plan) = est_tokens(shared_plan_prefix(plan)) against CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS (4096) so it reflects the bytes actually cached, while the container warm gate remains unchanged.
